items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: Yeah, I'd heard but I don't know too much about him.

ctx.x: But I came along in an era, since I'm a few years older than you -- I wondered did you ever hear or know anything about Louie Metcalfe?
Yeah, I'd heard but I don't know too much about him.
Well, he was one of the trumpet players, he played -- did some work at (unintelligible)
